attempts.answer: 不行啦，光是單程開車去墾丁就要五個小時，這樣玩一天就要走了

grade.headline: Solid refusal with 光是…就… used correctly; only the last clause sounds slightly off.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 不行啦，光是單程開車去墾丁就要五個小時，這樣玩不到一天就要回來了啦。

modelAnswers.chinese: 不行啦，光是開車下去就要五個小時，週末去根本玩不到什麼。
modelAnswers.note: 墾丁 is south, so 開車下去 is the idiomatic framing from Taipei.

modelAnswers.chinese: 這週末太趕了啦，光單程就五個鐘頭，來回十個小時，到那邊玩不到一天就要回來了。
modelAnswers.note: Spells out the round trip so the cost really bites.

issues.problem: Reads as 'play a whole day and then leave', which weakens your point — you want to stress you'd get less than a day.
issues.suggestion: 這樣玩不到一天就要回來了

strengths: 光是單程…就要五個小時 — 就 sits right before the concrete amount, exactly the target pattern
單程 is a precise way to isolate one leg of the trip
不行啦 fits texting a friend
grade.explanation: Your 光是…就… is textbook: 光是單程開車去墾丁就要五個小時 — isolated thing after 光是, 就 right before the price. The one fix is the payoff clause: use 玩不到一天 instead of 玩一天, since 不到 carries the 'barely' nuance. Also, from Taipei people usually say 開車下去墾丁 (下去 for heading south), which sounds more local than plain 開車去.

attempts.answer: 簡單也不代表便宜啦，光是訂場就要三十萬塊，更不用說食物或拍攝的部分

grade.headline: Great use of 光是…就…；just a couple of word-choice tweaks to sound more like home.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 簡單也不代表便宜啦，光是場地就要三十萬了，更不用說吃的跟攝影的部分了。

modelAnswers.chinese: 媽，就算簡單辦也不便宜啦，光是場地就要三十萬，更不用說吃的跟攝影師了。
modelAnswers.note: Most idiomatic: 媽+啦 keeps it warm, 光是…就 prices one piece, 更不用說…了 closes it.

modelAnswers.chinese: 已經很簡單了耶，光租場地就三十萬，吃的、拍照的都還沒算咧。
modelAnswers.note: Chattier alternative using 都還沒算 for the 'before you even get to…' tail.

issues.problem: Sounds clipped/Mainland-ish; in Taiwan you'd say 場地 or 租場地／訂場地.
issues.suggestion: 光是場地就要三十萬 / 光租場地就三十萬

issues.problem: 食物 is a bit clinical for wedding talk, and 或 makes it sound like a written list of options.

issues.learnerExcerpt: 更不用說食物或拍攝的部分
issues.problem: 更不用說 normally closes with 了 in speech — this was your correction point from before.
issues.suggestion: 更不用說吃的跟攝影師了

strengths: 光是場地就要三十萬塊 — exactly the right frame with a concrete amount
簡單也不代表便宜啦 is a nice natural rebuttal with warm 啦
三十萬 said correctly
grade.explanation: The 光是…就… structure landed perfectly — one isolated item plus a hard number is what makes it bite. Two polish points: use 場地 (or 租場地) rather than 訂場, and remember 更不用說 likes a closing 了: 更不用說吃的跟攝影師了。 For food in everyday talk, 吃的 beats 食物 (吃的、喝的、拍照的 are how people list wedding costs).

attempts.answer: 簡單也不代表便宜啦 光是場地就要三十萬了，更不用說吃的跟攝影

grade.headline: Very natural — 光是…就要三十萬了 lands perfectly; just close the 更不用說 clause with 了.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 媽，簡單也不代表便宜啦，光是場地就要三十萬了，更不用說吃的跟攝影師了。

modelAnswers.chinese: 媽，就算簡單辦也不便宜啦，光是場地就要三十萬了，更不用說吃的跟攝影師了。
modelAnswers.note: 就算…也 makes the concession to her suggestion explicit.

modelAnswers.chinese: 妳不知道現在行情啦，光場地就三十萬，吃的、攝影都還沒算咧。
modelAnswers.note: 都還沒算咧 is a very colloquial alternative to 更不用說.

issues.problem: 更不用說 is normally bracketed with a final 了 in speech; without it the sentence feels cut off. Also 攝影 (photography) is slightly off here — the cost item you listed with 吃的 is the person, 攝影師.
issues.suggestion: 更不用說吃的跟攝影師了

issues.problem: Understandable, but 不代表 is a bit abstract/argumentative for chatting with mom; 就算簡單辦也不便宜 ties back to her 簡單辦一辦 more directly.
issues.suggestion: 就算簡單辦也不便宜啦

strengths: 光是場地就要三十萬了 — textbook use: isolated noun phrase, 就 before the cost, concrete amount
三十萬 is the right way to say NT$300,000
啦 keeps it warm rather than lecturing
grade.explanation: The 光是…就… half is exactly right, and switching from 訂場 to 場地 reads more naturally. The one thing still missing from last time: 更不用說 is a paired frame in spoken Mandarin — 更不用說 X 了. The 了 is what signals the clause is done, e.g. 光是房租就兩萬了，更不用說水電了。Also keep the listed items parallel as cost categories: 吃的跟攝影師 (or 吃的、拍照的).

attempts.answer: 想要養狗的人是你，所以要遛牠的也應該是你吧

grade.headline: Both halves are proper clefts and it sounds genuinely spoken.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 想要養狗的人是你，所以要遛牠的也應該是你吧

modelAnswers.chinese: 說要養狗的是你，那要去遛狗的也是你啊。
modelAnswers.note: Bare 的 cleft twice, with 那…啊 for the accusatory tone.

modelAnswers.chinese: 當初吵著要養狗的是你耶，遛狗的當然也是你吧。
modelAnswers.note: 當初 + 吵著要 adds the 'you begged for it' flavour.

strengths: Double 的是 cleft done correctly — 的人是你 then 的也應該是你
也 + 吧 make it sound like real morning grumbling
所以 and 牠 are natural touches
grade.explanation: This is exactly the pattern: both halves pivot on 的…是你, which is what pins the responsibility on the other person. Keeping 的 in the second half is the whole point — 遛牠也是你 wouldn't work. One upgrade for flavour: Taiwanese speakers often front 當初 or say 吵著要養狗, e.g. 當初說要養狗的是你欸。

attempts.answer: 打壞build的人是他，所以要修的也應該是他吧，又不是我的工作

grade.headline: Both halves of the 的是 cleft are correct; just the verb 打壞 is off.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 弄壞 build 的是他，所以要修的也應該是他吧，又不是我的工作

modelAnswers.chinese: 弄壞 build 的是他，要修的也應該是他吧，又不是我的工作。
modelAnswers.note: Cleanest version of what you wrote.

modelAnswers.chinese: build 是他搞壞的，那要修的當然也是他啊，又不是我負責的。
modelAnswers.note: 是…的 focus in the first half, 負責 instead of 工作 — very natural on Slack.

issues.problem: 打壞 isn't used for a build; 打 implies striking/physical breakage. Also 的人 is fine but the bare 的 is punchier.
issues.suggestion: 弄壞 build 的是他／build 是他搞壞的／他把 build 弄掛了

strengths: 的 present in both halves: 弄壞…的是他 / 要修的也應該是他
又不是我的工作 — exactly the spoken concessive move, not the stiff 不是我的責任
吧 adds just the right mildly annoyed softening
grade.explanation: The double cleft is solid — you kept 的 in both halves, which is what makes the blame-assignment feel pointed rather than just descriptive. The only fix is collocation: for software, breakage is 弄壞／搞壞／弄掛 (他把 build 弄掛了), while 打壞 and 打破 belong to physical objects (打破杯子). Also note 的人是他 → 的是他 is slightly tighter and more idiomatic in this cleft.

attempts.answer: 我們以為加了兩個工程師之後進度就會變快，可是什麼反而都慢下來了

grade.headline: Good setup with 以為, but the final clause's word order breaks and 可是 loses the "結果" punch.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 我們以為加了兩個工程師之後進度就會變快，結果反而什麼都慢下來了

modelAnswers.chinese: 我們本來想說多加兩個工程師，release 可以快一點，結果進度反而更慢。
modelAnswers.note: The most idiomatic frame: 本來想說… + 結果 + 主語反而…

modelAnswers.chinese: 我們以為多兩個工程師會比較快，沒想到反而整個拖得更久。
modelAnswers.note: 沒想到 carries the surprise; 拖得更久 is very natural for schedules.

issues.problem: Broken word order — 什麼…都 is a fixed pair and can't be split by 反而. 反而 goes before the whole predicate.
issues.suggestion: 反而什麼都慢下來了 / 進度反而更慢

issues.problem: 可是 is a flat contrast; here you want the "and then the result was…" flavour that sets up 反而.
Vague for a software complaint; Taiwanese speakers name the thing that slowed — 進度.

strengths: 以為 correctly sets up the dashed expectation
工程師 written correctly this time (last attempt had 工程人)
grade.explanation: The expectation-setup half is solid. Two fixes: use 結果／沒想到 (not 可是) to land the reversal, and keep 反而 immediately before the full predicate — it can't slot inside 什麼…都. Safest spoken template: 本來想說…，結果 + 主語 + 反而 + …，e.g. 結果進度反而更慢 or 結果反而拖得更久.

attempts.answer: 我試著讓他們之間的事沒那麼緊繃，但反而搞得更緊繃了

grade.headline: 反而 is in the right slot, but the first half is a wordy calque and 緊繃 repeats awkwardly.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 我本來想說幫他們兩個緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵。

modelAnswers.chinese: 我本來想說幫他們兩個緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵。
modelAnswers.note: Most idiomatic: 本來想說 sets the expectation, 結果反而 flips it, 搞得更僵 is the standard collocation for strained relations.

modelAnswers.chinese: 本來想當和事佬，沒想到他們兩個反而更僵了。
modelAnswers.note: 和事佬 = peacemaker; here 反而 sits after the subject 他們兩個.

issues.learnerExcerpt: 我試著讓他們之間的事沒那麼緊繃
issues.problem: Word-by-word rendering of 'I tried to... between the two of them'. 試著 + 讓…的事沒那麼… is clunky; spoken Taiwanese Mandarin front-loads the intention with 本來想說／本來以為.
issues.suggestion: 我本來想說幫他們兩個緩和一下

issues.problem: 但 is weak here — 結果／沒想到 pairs much better with 反而 for a thwarted expectation. Repeating 緊繃 also sounds flat.

strengths: 反而 placed correctly before the predicate
搞得更… is exactly the right collocation
grade.explanation: The 反而 slot is right — the problem is the setup. English "I tried to X" becomes 本來想說… in spoken Mandarin, not 試著…; 本來 already carries the "I meant to, but it didn't work out" flavour, and it builds the expectation that 反而 then reverses. Pair it with 結果／沒想到 rather than 但: 本來想說幫他們緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵。 For a rift between people, 僵 is the native word (關係很僵／搞得更僵); 緊繃 leans more toward atmosphere or nerves.

attempts.answer: 我本來想說幫他們緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵

grade.headline: Spot on — exactly how a Taiwanese speaker would put it.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 我本來想說幫他們兩個緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵。

modelAnswers.chinese: 我本來想說幫他們兩個緩和一下，結果反而搞得更僵。
modelAnswers.note: The core frame: 本來想說… for the intention, 結果反而… for the reversal.

modelAnswers.chinese: 本來想當和事佬，沒想到他們兩個反而更僵了。
modelAnswers.note: 和事佬 = peacemaker; note 反而 after the subject 他們兩個.

strengths: 本來想說…，結果反而… frame used perfectly
搞得更僵 — idiomatic collocation for a relationship going stiff/awkward
Dropped the 試著 calque from your first attempt
grade.explanation: This is the portable frame to keep: 本來想說 sets up the expectation, 結果反而 flips it. Note that 反而 here sits before the verb with no second-clause subject; if you add one it goes after it (他們兩個反而更僵了), never before. Optional polish: 他們兩個 sounds slightly fuller than 他們 when referring to a specific pair.

attempts.answer: 加個欄位才不是你想的那麼簡單吧，當初兩年前架的時候他們為了趕上線日期而走了很多捷徑，現在正在還技術債，價位邏輯很複雜，還有光是弄清楚價錢到底在哪裡算出來就要兩天，如果試著一個禮拜內完成，恐怕會造成多一點bug，上線也比較慢

grade.headline: All three goals land and the tech-debt collocations are right — but the opening sounds a bit combative and a few word choices are off.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 我知道看起來只是加個欄位啦，可是這個真的沒那麼簡單。結帳是兩年前趕出來的，當初為了趕上線抄了很多捷徑，我們現在就是在還技術債。價格計算的邏輯很亂，光是搞清楚價錢到底在哪裡算的就要兩天。如果硬壓在一個禮拜內做完，反而會多出更多 bug，上線搞不好更慢。

modelAnswers.chinese: 我知道看起來只是加一個欄位啦，可是結帳那塊兩年前為了趕上線抄了很多捷徑，我們現在就是在還技術債。光是搞清楚價格到底在哪裡算的就要兩三天，硬要下禮拜上的話，反而會多出更多 bug，最後更慢。
modelAnswers.note: Opens by validating her view (…啦) so it doesn't sound defensive, then 光是…就要 + 反而.

modelAnswers.chinese: 這個真的不是我們在拖啦。結帳的程式碼當初是趕出來的，先求有再求好，技術債越滾越大，一動就壞。光找出折扣會影響到哪些地方就要兩天，趕的話搞不好反而拖更久。
modelAnswers.note: Alternative with 先求有再求好 and 技術債越滾越大.

issues.learnerExcerpt: 加個欄位才不是你想的那麼簡單吧
issues.problem: To a PM under pressure this lands as a pushback (才不是你想的… + 吧 ≈ 'it's not what YOU think'). The task was to explain without getting defensive.
issues.suggestion: 我知道看起來只是加個欄位啦，可是真的沒那麼簡單

issues.problem: 價位 means 'price point / price range', not the computed price. Also 價位邏輯 isn't a collocation.
issues.suggestion: 價格計算的邏輯很亂 / 算價格的邏輯很亂

issues.learnerExcerpt: 為了趕上線日期而走了很多捷徑
issues.problem: 趕上線 is already complete — 上線日期 is wordy, and the 而 is written register. Spoken: drop both.
issues.suggestion: 為了趕上線抄了很多捷徑

issues.learnerExcerpt: 恐怕會造成多一點bug，上線也比較慢
issues.problem: Two things: 多一點 understates it (you mean *more* bugs than otherwise), and the backfire nuance needs 反而. 造成 bug is also a bit stiff — 多出 bug / 出更多問題 is what devs say.
issues.suggestion: 反而會多出更多 bug，上線搞不好更慢

issues.learnerExcerpt: 如果試著一個禮拜內完成
issues.problem: 試著 sounds like a tentative experiment; here the point is being forced to rush.
issues.suggestion: 如果硬壓在一個禮拜內做完 / 硬要下禮拜上的話

strengths: 趕上線 + 走了很多捷徑 + 現在正在還技術債 — the whole tech-debt chain is correct and idiomatic
光是弄清楚價錢到底在哪裡算出來就要兩天 — exactly the concrete sub-task pricing the reference wants
Natural spoken flow overall; no 代碼/部署 traps
grade.explanation: Your technical content was all there — 趕上線, 走捷徑, 還技術債, and the 光是…就要兩天 cost estimate. Two upgrades: (1) frame-setting. Starting with 才不是你想的那麼簡單吧 puts her on the defensive; conceding first (我知道看起來只是加個欄位啦，可是…) buys you the right to explain. (2) 反而 is the word that carries 'rushing backfires': 硬趕反而會多出更多 bug — without it, 恐怕會造成多一點 bug 上線也比較慢 reads as two separate mild predictions instead of one counterintuitive consequence. Also watch 價位 (price point) vs 價格 (the price itself).

drills.lesson: Concede first, then explain — and use 反而 for the counterintuitive backfire
drills.targetExpression: 我知道…啦，可是… ／ 反而…
drills.english: I know it looks like a small change, but if we squeeze it into this release, we'll actually slow the whole team down.
drills.context: To your tech lead, who wants one more feature in Friday's release
referenceAnswers: 我知道看起來只是個小改動啦，可是硬塞進這次 release 的話，反而會拖累整個團隊的進度。
我知道這個改動看起來不大啦，可是如果硬要擠進這次上線，反而會讓大家都變慢。

attempts.answer: 我知道看起來像是小的改變，但如果硬壓在這個release裡面，反而會讓整個team變慢

grade.headline: 反而 lands well; a few collocations sound translated.
grade.correctedLearnerAnswer: 我知道看起來只是個小改動啦，但如果硬塞進這個 release，反而會讓整個 team 變慢。

modelAnswers.chinese: 我知道這看起來只是個小改動啦，可是硬塞進這次 release，反而會拖累整個 team 的進度。

grade.explanation: 「小的改變」is calque-ish — Taiwanese devs say 小改動/小改一下; and 硬壓在…裡面 → 硬塞進/硬擠進. Add the 啦 after 我知道…, which is what makes the concession sound soft rather than defensive.
